tasks.label: SDK: 打包 Windows .dll
args: New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force -Path 'dist/sdk/windows-amd64' | Out-Null; if (-not (Get-Command gcc -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue)) { Write-Error '未找到 gcc（MinGW-w64），请先安装 MinGW-w64'; exit 1 }; $env:CGO_ENABLED='1'; $env:GOOS='windows'; $env:GOARCH='amd64'; $env:CC='gcc'; go build -tags dll -buildmode=c-shared -ldflags '-s -w' -trimpath -o 'dist/sdk/windows-amd64/nebula.dll' ./nebula/app
tasks.detail: 编译预编译 SDK（Windows x64 .dll + nebula.h，需 MinGW-w64 gcc）

tasks.label: 发布: 清空 dist 文件夹
args: if (Test-Path dist) { Remove-Item dist/* -Recurse -Force; Write-Host 'dist 文件夹已清空' } else { New-Item dist -ItemType Directory | Out-Null; Write-Host 'dist 文件夹已创建' }
tasks.detail: 清空 dist 构建输出目录

tasks.label: 发布: 更新版本号
tasks.detail: 更新 embed.go 与 versioninfo.json 中的版本号

tasks.label: 发布: 重新生成 resource.syso
args: if (Get-Command goversioninfo -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue) { Push-Location 'nebula\app\win'; goversioninfo -64; Pop-Location; Write-Host 'resource.syso 已重新生成' } else { Write-Host '未安装 goversioninfo，跳过（exe 文件版本信息保持旧值）' -ForegroundColor Yellow }
tasks.detail: 用 goversioninfo 重新生成 exe 版本资源

tasks.label: 发布: git 提交并打标签
args: $v=(Get-Content -Raw (Join-Path $env:TEMP 'nebula_release_ver.txt')); git add -A; git commit -m ('release: v'+$v); git tag -f v$v
tasks.detail: git add -A + commit + 打标签 v<版本>

tasks.label: 发布: 推送 GitHub + Gitee
args: if (Get-NetTCPConnection -LocalPort 7890 -State Listen -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue) { $env:HTTP_PROXY='http://127.0.0.1:7890'; $env:HTTPS_PROXY='http://127.0.0.1:7890' }; $v=(Get-Content -Raw (Join-Path $env:TEMP 'nebula_release_ver.txt')); $b=git branch --show-current; git push origin $b; if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { exit 1 }; git push --force origin refs/tags/v$v; if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { exit 1 }; $tok=[Environment]::GetEnvironmentVariable('GITEE_TOKEN','User'); if (-not $tok) { Write-Host '未找到 GITEE_TOKEN，请先设置'; exit 1 }; git push --force "https://cjxpj:$tok@gitee.com/cjxpj/nebula.git" $b; if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { exit 1 }; git push --force "https://cjxpj:$tok@gitee.com/cjxpj/nebula.git" refs/tags/v$v
tasks.detail: 推送分支+tag 到 GitHub(origin) 与 Gitee（自动启用代理）

tasks.label: 发布: 创建 GitHub Release
args: if (Get-NetTCPConnection -LocalPort 7890 -State Listen -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue) { $env:HTTP_PROXY='http://127.0.0.1:7890'; $env:HTTPS_PROXY='http://127.0.0.1:7890' }; $gh='C:\Program Files\GitHub CLI\gh.exe'; $v=(Get-Content -Raw (Join-Path $env:TEMP 'nebula_release_ver.txt')); $n=(Get-Content -Raw -Encoding UTF8 (Join-Path $PWD '.vscode/release-notes.md')).Trim(); if (-not $n) { $n=('Nebula v'+$v+' 发布') }; & $gh release create v$v dist/nebula.exe dist/nebula dist/nebula.apk --repo cjxpj/nebula --title v$v --notes $n
tasks.detail: gh 创建 GitHub Release 并上传 exe/linux/apk

tasks.label: 发布: 创建 Gitee Release
args: $tok=[Environment]::GetEnvironmentVariable('GITEE_TOKEN','User'); if (-not $tok) { Write-Host '未找到 GITEE_TOKEN，请先设置'; exit 1 }; $v=(Get-Content -Raw (Join-Path $env:TEMP 'nebula_release_ver.txt')); $n=(Get-Content -Raw -Encoding UTF8 (Join-Path $PWD '.vscode/release-notes.md')).Trim(); $body=@{access_token=$tok; tag_name=('v'+$v); name=('v'+$v); body=$n; target_commitish=(git branch --show-current)} | ConvertTo-Json; $rel=Invoke-RestMethod -Method Post -Uri 'https://gitee.com/api/v5/repos/cjxpj/nebula/releases' -ContentType 'application/json; charset=utf-8' -Body ([System.Text.Encoding]::UTF8.GetBytes($body)); curl.exe -s -X POST "https://gitee.com/api/v5/repos/cjxpj/nebula/releases/$($rel.id)/attach_files" -F "access_token=$tok" -F 'file=@dist/nebula.exe'; curl.exe -s -X POST "https://gitee.com/api/v5/repos/cjxpj/nebula/releases/$($rel.id)/attach_files" -F "access_token=$tok" -F 'file=@dist/nebula'; curl.exe -s -X POST "https://gitee.com/api/v5/repos/cjxpj/nebula/releases/$($rel.id)/attach_files" -F "access_token=$tok" -F 'file=@dist/nebula.apk'
tasks.detail: Gitee API 创建 Release 并上传 exe/linux/apk

tasks.label: 发布: 输入版本号
tasks.detail: 开头提问一次版本号；更新说明请填写 .vscode/release-notes.md（留空则用默认说明）

发布: 推送 GitHub + Gitee
发布: 创建 GitHub Release
发布: 创建 Gitee Release
